items.text: The failure is centered in `updateFieldArrayRootError`: it always turns a non-array error object into a one-element array. That is correct for a bare root error, but wrong for the mixed object shape because numeric keys become trapped under array index `0`. I’m checking the existing regression coverage and utility conventions before patching the discriminator.

I’ll preserve an existing object only when it has numeric own keys, leaving bare root-only objects on the established array-plus-`root` representation. I’ll add coverage for the resolver/mutation/targeted-trigger sequence so the distinction is locked down.
